thread:
isaac: URGENT: partner reported active exploitation of cloud-kms-client. token-replay -> decrypt of cached keys. suspected in-the-wild. CVE assigned: CVE-2026-12345. please triage ASAP.

maya: seen similar spikes in decrypt errors on prod around 03:18 UTC, correlates with odd replay_count header. forwarding logs to thread.

ellie: quick note — maintainers released cloud-kms-client 1.2.4 with server-side nonce checks + cache bypass flag. patch script in repo.

rory: can we hotfix images? list of services using client: keymgr, model-store, eval-runner, data-ingest. i will schedule rolling deploys to non-critical zones first.

sresimon: mitigation plan: 1) set CLOUD_KMS_CACHE=0 in env for all pods 2) rotate service account keys for KMS clients 3) tighten IAM to deny Decrypt except resource-scoped keys 4) patch images to 1.2.4 and restart.

isaac: agreed. prioritize keymgr and model-store first (they hold long-lived wrapped keys).

ellie: patch PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/cloud-kms-client/pull/342 — includes CVE footnote + migration steps. test matrix OK.

rory: canary: rolling patch started for keymgr in us-west-2 canary -> will monitor tail -n 200 /var/log/keymgr/*.log for replay_count spikes.

deploy-bot: build-redwood/keymgr:1.2.4-rc -> image built (sha256:fa3db2). staging deploy queued.

security-bot: Added incident tag "cve-2026-12345" to thread and created internal advisory doc at /security/advisories/cve-2026-12345 (internal).

product-ops: we need comms. draft advisory for customers ready? include impacted services, mitigation steps, ETA for full rollout, and recommended actions (rotate KMS keys, disable client caching).

isaac: comms checklist: (a) public advisory template (b) customer-facing mitigation steps + kubectl snippet (c) notify enterprise accounts directly d1/d2.

maya: kubectl snippet to disable cache quickly:
```
kubectl -n <ns> set env deployment/<svc> CLOUD_KMS_CACHE=0
kubectl rollout restart deployment/<svc>
```

isaac: also run this across helm releases: helm upgrade --reuse-values --set global.kms.cache=false <release> <chart>

ellie: important: some on-prem customers use vendor-embedded client; we need to send patch binary + patch instructions. security-bot, can you enumerate customers using embedded builds?

security-bot: Querying asset inventory... returning list: AcmeAnalytics, NovaHealth, FinLedger (3 enterprise accounts with embedded client). Will attach contact owners.

rory: RBAC mitigation: create temporary IAM condition block to deny Decrypt unless request attribute nonce_verified==true. pushed policy change to staging account, monitoring for failures.

sresimon: rotation steps (short): 1) create new CMK 2) rewrap/decrypt tooling — run rewrap job in controlled window 3) revoke old key decrypt perms 4) rotate client SA creds. I will draft runbook.

product-ops: timeline for customer advisory?

isaac: publishing internal advisory in 1h, customer advisory in 3h (after canary + keymgr patch looks good). enterprise outreach asap.

ellie: CI note: add integration test that asserts replay_count increases trigger nonce check fail. I'll open follow-up PR.

rory: initial canary shows replay_count drops to zero after 6m post-patch. logging shows nonce_mismatch events blocked. looks good so far.

deploy-bot: keymgr production roll to us-west-2 started at 1834501500, 10 pods rolling with maxUnavailable=1.

maya: capturing list of affected images from runtime manifests and sending to infra channel for emergency rebuilds.

security-bot: CVE-2026-12345 advisory draft created. severity: High (9.1). IAL:public disclosure scheduled after 72h coordinated disclosure window.

isaac: action owners summary: ellie -> publish patch + PR; rory -> RBAC policy + rollout; sresimon -> rotate plan + runbook; maya -> logs + detection rule; product-ops -> customer comms; deploy-bot -> image builds and deploys. Keep updates here.

product-ops: acknowledged, drafting customer advisory now. will ping legal for wording.

ellie: PR merged to main at 1834501602. patch package uploaded to releases (1.2.4).

rory: started service account rotation for keymgr at 1834501650, small blast radius first. monitoring.

maya: detection rule suggestion for SIEM:
```
when replay_count > 3 and source != trusted_ip then alert("kms-token-replay")
```

isaac: good. add runbook step to block source IP ranges at edge if seen repeated exploit attempts.

sresimon: runbook rough draft at /runbooks/kms-token-replay.md — will finish post-rotation.

deploy-bot: model-store image build queued, ETA 20m.

isaac: excellent work team. keep updates short here. if anyone sees new evidence of data exfil, escalate to incident channel and ping exec-security.

ellie: final note — upstream maintainers thanked us for quick reporting. they will publish CVE notes and backport to 1.1.x branch. we should follow up on backports for older embedded builds.

rory: rolling patch complete for keymgr and model-store at 1834501787. post-patch metrics look stable.

isaac: closing initial triage thread — moving to incident tracker with runbook and comms items. follow-ups in #incidents. :thumbsup:
